name: Lifesteil Appartementresort
beschreibung: The Lifesteil Appartementresort is located in the municipality of Umhausen in the Ötztal. The surroundings are shaped by the alpine landscape of Tirol and offer numerous hiking and skiing opportunities. The holiday apartments feature modern amenities, including a fully equipped kitchen and modern bathrooms. A wellness area with sauna and steam bath complements the offering for guests. The atmosphere at the resort is quiet and geared toward relaxation, so both couples and families feel at home here. The location away from main traffic allows for an undisturbed stay. In the surrounding area, the Stuibenfall and the Freizeitzentrum Umhausen are also quickly reachable.
